newsitem.title: USA: Gannett cites USA Today, TV ad growth.
newsitem.headline: Gannett cites USA Today, TV ad growth.

text.p: Gannett Inc Monday reported a 28 percent increase in earnings per share from continuing operations to $0.82, citing advertising demand at its telesivion stations and at USA Today.
Profit from the sale of Gannett Outdoor boosted net income to $2.94 per share.
The latest quarter included operations of Multimedia Inc, purchased in December 1995, the company said.
These properties continued to boost operating cash flow, but incremental interest, taxes and goodwill amortization tempered the contribution to earnings per share.
The broadcast group achieved record results in the latest quarter, buoyed by Summer Olympics advertising on its nine NBC-affiliated television stations, Gannett said.

Newspaper profitability benefited from robust advertising demand at USA Today and from the cycling through of the Detroit strike which began on July 13, 1995. The loss at the Detroit News was substantially lower than in the third quarter last year, Gannett said.
Newsprint expense was 16 percent higher than last year, it said. If current trends continued, the company added, fourth quarter newsprint costs would be lower than in 1995.
